title: Optional additional cost '[fury]' is never offered when playing Pyke
expected: Pyke's hand-authored card def (packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/pyke-dockside-butcher.ts:14-34) declares only Hidden, Ganking, and the paid-additional-cost triggered ability; because `abilities` is explicitly set, enrichCard skips rulesText parsing (data/enrich-cards.ts:23), so no `{type:"static", effect:{type:"additional-cost-option", additionalCost}}` ability exists. getOptionalPlayCost (riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/play/cost.ts:909-1024) only returns a cost for Accelerate / kill / static additional-cost-option shapes, so it returns undefined for unl-028-219 and resolvePayableOptionalCost (play-unit.ts:71-79) never yields a paid variant. Verified at runtime via getAllCards(): Pyke's loaded abilities have no additional-cost-option entry, whereas Gust Monk ven-101-166 (parsed from rulesText) has `{type:"static", effect:{type:"additional-cost-option", additionalCost:":rb_energy_1:", optional:true}}`.
observed: Only the unpaid playUnit variants are enumerated (base / battlefields / hideCard) even with power {fury:1-2}. Forcing executeMove playUnit with paidAdditionalCost:true + additionalCostSpec {power:['fury']} was accepted but charged only 3 energy, left fury power unspent, and Pyke entered exhausted at 2 Might (trigger did not fire). Root cause: card definition (packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/pyke-dockside-butcher.ts, confirmed via /api/cards/unl-028-219) has only Hidden, Ganking and the paid-additional-cost triggered ability — no static additional-cost-option ability, so getOptionalPlayCost() returns undefined and resolvePayableOptionalCost never yields a paid variant.
